unit.why: A short dream narrative attributed to R. Shlomo of Karlin: a simple man who saved a life dies, enters paradise and is helped there by R. Shlomo. It is framed by a teaching on the reward of a commandment.
unit.boundary_note: The section heading 'מענין פיקוח נפש' sits at the end of the previous division. The trailing heading 'מענין פסיק רישא' belongs to the next division.

stories.start_quote: כמו ששמעתי בשם הק׳ ר״ש מקארלין
stories.summary_en: R. Shlomo of Karlin dreamt of a simple man of his time who saved a life and died soon after. Because of that merit he entered paradise, though at first it was a paradise shaped like his worldly affairs, until R. Shlomo came to his aid. This illustrates that the reward of a commandment is a further commandment, the service of God.
